name: Matthew Brach
office: City of Rancho Palos Verdes, Member of the City Council

items.text: Matthew Brach is a CEO. He has served on the Rancho Palos Verdes Planning Commission. He previously was president of the Palos Verdes Peninsula Unified School District Board of Education and president of the Southern California Regional Occupational Center.

sentences.text: He has served on the Rancho Palos Verdes Planning Commission.
He previously was president of the Palos Verdes Peninsula Unified School District Board of Education and president of the Southern California Regional Occupational Center.

items.text: In 2020, he was the named plaintiff in a lawsuit challenging Governor Gavin Newsom’s order closing schools during the COVID-19 pandemic. At an October 2026 candidate forum, he said the city should act to prevent land movement from being a continuing drain on finances and that public safety, including police and wildfire response, is a fundamental government duty. He also said the city should prioritize its needs over its wants.
